provenance.note: A map of displacement from the live house-spell reading, fitted on paired differences: the same seed rendered at the house and at the spell. origin is that live reading, not the golden HOUSE vector — they disagree (Spark 0.48 against 0.275) and adding a live delta onto the vector was reporting the wrong reach. The house knot is nought by construction. A reading outside the reach is clamped onto it and inverted onto the house-nearest die of a plateau. table is the sweep at eight bars; attempt asks by nearest row, not by eight independent inverses.
